meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析你提供的文本,按12个认知维度逐项打分,判断作者的推理方式与决策习惯,产出一份认知画像;若提供多个人的文本,还会比较他们的思维异同;也可用对话历史分析你自己的思维。
howto.when: 当你说出“我的思维风格是什么”“分析这个人的推理方式”等话,或给出文本想了解作者的认知特点时触发;也支持对比多人的思维风格。

say.text: 分析这段文章作者的思维风格
say.note: Claude 会按12个维度打分并生成画像

say.text: 比较这两个人的思考方式有什么不同
say.note: 生成两份画像并做对比

say.text: 根据我们的对话,分析我的思考模式
say.note: 以对话历史为样本来分析

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your text, scores 12 cognitive dimensions, and outputs a cognitive profile of the author (reasoning, decision style). With multiple texts it compares thinking styles. Can profile your own thinking from chat history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about thinking style, cognitive profile, or reasoning patterns; when you provide text to understand its author's cognition; or when comparing thinking styles between people.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this article's author.
say_en.note: Scores it and builds a profile.

say_en.text: Compare how these two people think differently.
Profile my thinking based on our conversation.
say_en.note: Uses chat history as the sample.
